name: wechat-minigame
description: Adapt game projects for WeChat Mini Games and verify their developer-tool and device builds.

interface.shortDescription: Adapt, preview, and check WeChat mini-game builds.
interface.longDescription: Combine with the project's engine workflow to configure WeChat Mini Games, inspect packaging, and verify builds in WeChat DevTools and on a device. Requires WeChat DevTools and an authorized mini-game AppID for account-dependent operations. Includes no third-party MCP bridge. Disabled by default; build, upload, review, and release remain distinct steps.
defaultPrompt: Check this project's WeChat Mini Game integration and local prerequisites.
Build this game for WeChat and prepare developer-tool and device checks without uploading.
